hypothesis: The conditioning advantage of exact-value identity transfers to all numerical columns when cumulative PLE is changed to an information-equivalent local hat basis over the same knots.
selection_rule: A transferable candidate must beat cumulative PLE in mean normalized score and on at least six of nine datasets. Any claimed per-dataset safeguard must be chosen by validation loss and evaluated on untouched test targets.

confirmation_if_screen_passes.compute_matched_control: validation-tuned blend of two cumulative-PLE model seeds
